54:28.text: And inform them that the water is to be shared between
them, each one’s right to drink being established

54:29.text: But they called their comrade and he took

54:30.text: was My Torment and My Warnings?

54:31.text: Verily, We sent against them a single Saihah
, and they became like the stubble of a fold-builder.

54:32.text: And indeed, We have made the Qur’ân easy to understand and remember; then is there any that will remember

54:34.text: Verily, We sent against them a violent storm of stones
, them We saved in the last hour of the night,

54:35.text: As a Favour from Us. Thus do We reward him who gives thanks

54:36.text: indeed had warned them of Our Seizure
, but they did doubt the warnings!

54:37.text: And they indeed sought to shame his guest
(by asking to commit sodomy with them)
"Then taste you My Torment and My Warnings."

54:38.text: And verily, an abiding torment seized them early in the morning.

54:39.text: "Then taste you My Torment and My Warnings."

54:40.text: And indeed, We have made the Qur’ân easy to understand and remember; then is there any that will remember

54:41.text: And indeed, warnings came to the people of Fir‘aun

54:42.text: belied all Our Signs, so We seized them with a Seizure of the All-Mighty, All-Capable

54:43.text: , Sâlih, and the people of Fir‘aun
who were destroyed)? Or have you an immunity

54:44.text: Or say they: "We are a great multitude, victorious?"

54:45.text: Their multitude will be put to flight, and they will show their backs.

54:46.text: Nay, but the Hour is their appointed time
, and the Hour will be more grievous and more bitter.

54:48.text: The Day they will be dragged on their faces into the Fire

54:49.text: Verily, We have created all things with Qadar
(Divine Preordainments of all things before their creation as written in the Book of Decrees Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz)
